Original dataset name: OpenStreetMap (OSM) pedestrian network and service POIs via OSMnx/Overpass
Year / download date: OSM snapshot used in analysis GPKG dated 2026-06-01 (method reused 2026-07-29)
Spatial resolution: Network edges + POI points; scores on 500 m hex centroids (n = 1,539; EPSG:25832)
Filtering rules: network_type = walk, undirected; destinations snapped if ≤200 m from graph; study area = Odense municipality
Service–facility categories: food_retail; health; education_childcare; food_drink; civic_daily_services; recreation
Weighting scheme: Category weights 0.25 / 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.15 / 0.15 / 0.10; distance decay s = exp(−d/700), β = 700 m; walking speed 1.34 m/s; 15 min cutoff (~1,206 m)
Missing-value proportion: 0% NaN; 655/1,539 hexes (42.6%) beyond 15 min for all categories (score = 0)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Multi-source Dijkstra network distance to nearest facility per category; hex-centroid evaluation; no spatial interpolation of scores
Standardization direction: Positive (higher = better access); municipality min–max to 0–100

Original dataset name: OpenStreetMap (OSM) bicycle network and service POIs via OSMnx/Overpass
Spatial resolution: Bicycle network + POI points; 500 m hex (EPSG:25832)
Filtering rules: network_type = bike, undirected; destinations snapped if ≤250 m; Odense municipality clip
Service–facility categories: Same taxonomy as walking: food_retail; health; education_childcare; food_drink; civic_daily_services; recreation
Weighting scheme: Same category weights as walking; decay s = exp(−d/1,800), β = 1,800 m; speed 15 km/h; 15 min cutoff (3,750 m)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Network distance on bike graph; hex-centroid evaluation

Original dataset name: OpenStreetMap (OSM) bicycle network and service POIs via OSMnx/Overpass
Spatial resolution: Bicycle network + POI points; 500 m hex (EPSG:25832)
Weighting scheme: Same weights/decay as bike_access_15m; 5 min cutoff (1,250 m)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Network distance on bike graph; hex-centroid evaluation

Original dataset name: OpenStreetMap PT stops/stations/platforms/hubs + OSM walk network (OSMnx; not GTFS)
Spatial resolution: PT stop points + walk network; 500 m hex (EPSG:25832)
Filtering rules: Stops snapped if ≤200 m from walk graph; stop-access potential only (no timetable/frequency)
Weighting scheme: 50% nearest all-stop score + 50% PT-category composite; decay β = 1,000 m; walk 1.34 m/s; 20 min cutoff (~1,608 m)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Walk-network distance to nearest stop(s); hex-centroid evaluation
Standardization direction: Positive (higher = better stop access); min–max to 0–100

Original dataset name: OpenStreetMap PT stops/stations + OSM walk network (OSMnx)
Spatial resolution: PT stop points + walk network; 500 m hex (EPSG:25832)
Weighting scheme: Same composite rule; 10 min cutoff (~804 m)

Filtering rules: Official natural/green GeoDanmark classes only; agriculture excluded from green composite; clipped to Odense
Weighting scheme: Area share = green_area / hex_area × 100; quality composite weight 0.18 (pre-renormalisation)
Standardization direction: Positive (higher green share = higher environmental quality)

Filtering rules: Official built-up classes (buildings, urban core, high/low density settlement, commercial, etc.); Odense clip
Weighting scheme: Area share (%); enters quality as inverse (weight 0.12) and burden as direct (0.18)
Standardization direction: Negative for environmental quality (higher built-up = lower quality); positive for urban intensity/morphology

Spatial resolution: Lines buffered 50 m; share on 500 m hex
Filtering rules: Major roads only (motorway, main route, primary/secondary route classes); municipal clip
Weighting scheme: Buffered area / hex area × 100; quality inverse weight 0.10; burden weight 0.15
Standardization direction: Negative for environmental quality (higher exposure = lower quality)

Original dataset name: Multi-source official stack: GeoDanmark natural/blue/built-up/roads; WDPA ∪ LBST §3 nature; Vejdirektoratet state-road noise (2022); ESA CLIM4cities summer LST; interim Open-Meteo/CAMS NO₂
Year / download date: Official layers processed 2026-07-29 (noise mapping year 2022; LST scenes Jun–Aug 2020–2023)
Spatial resolution: Polygon overlays + ~50–100 m rasters; composite on 500 m hex
Filtering rules: Only non-constant available components retained; weights renormalised; state-road noise footprint only; air = interim proxy
Weighting scheme: Candidate weights (pre-renorm): green 0.18; blue 0.08; built-up⁻¹ 0.12; road⁻¹ 0.10; official natural 0.15; protected/§3 0.12; noise-share⁻¹ 0.08; heat⁻¹ 0.09; noise-mean⁻¹ 0.08
Missing-value proportion: Composite defined for all hexes; component gaps: heat 13/1,539 (0.8%); noise mean 1,150/1,539 (74.7% outside state-road footprint); air 0%
Interpolation / aggregation method: Area shares + zonal means of rasters; weighted sum of min–max component norms
Standardization direction: Positive (higher = better environmental quality); municipality min–max to 0–100

Original dataset name: Same official multi-source stack as env_quality
Filtering rules: Same components with burden polarity; dropped from GMM due to |r| ≈ 0.96 with env_quality
Weighting scheme: Candidate weights: low green 0.12; built-up 0.18; road 0.15; low natural 0.10; low eco 0.10; noise share 0.10; heat 0.12; noise mean 0.08; air 0.05
Standardization direction: Negative for liveability (higher = greater environmental pressure); min–max to 0–100

Original dataset name: WDPA Denmark (Protected Planet) ∪ LBST §3 protected nature
Filtering rules: Merged protected/§3 features clipped to Odense

Original dataset name: ESA CLIM4cities Sentinel-3 SLSTR downscaled LST (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20863040)
Spatial resolution: Raster ≈100 m; zonal mean on 500 m hex
Filtering rules: Summer scenes over Odense; LST (not canopy air temperature)
Weighting scheme: Zonal mean; quality as inverse (0.09); burden direct (0.12)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Zonal mean of raster cells intersecting hex
Standardization direction: Negative for environmental quality (higher LST = lower quality)

Spatial resolution: Polygon Lden bands / ≈50 m raster; zonal mean on 500 m hex
Filtering rules: State roads only (not full municipal network)
Weighting scheme: Band midpoints for rasterisation; quality inverse (0.08); burden direct (0.08)
Missing-value proportion: 1,150/1,539 hexes (74.7%) outside state-road noise footprint (no measured mean)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Zonal mean / noise-area share within hex

Original dataset name: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS-based); interim pending DCE national mapping
Spatial resolution: Coarse regional raster; zonal mean on 500 m hex
Filtering rules: Interim placeholder only; not Danish national AirGIS/DCE product
Standardization direction: Negative for environmental quality / positive for burden

Original dataset name: 1 km population-density class map (PopulationDensity_InMainDistrict) scaled to municipal population total KOMM_TOT_21 (Odense, 205,987)
Year / download date: Municipal total year 2021; density-class layer project GIS (~2025); hex product 2026-07-29
Spatial resolution: Native: 1 km square density-class cells; analysis: areal-interpolated to 500 m hex
Filtering rules: Density classes mapped to midpoints (1–19→10; 20–49→34.5; 50–99→74.5; 100–149→124.5; 150–399→274.5; ≥400→500 persons km⁻²); scaled so Σ population = 205,987
Weighting scheme: None for density itself; used as continuous morphology feature in GMM (z-standardised with other features)
Missing-value proportion: 0% after construction (estimate defined for all hexes intersecting study area)
Interpolation / aggregation method: Areal interpolation from 1 km class grid to 500 m hex; density = hex population / hex area
Standardization direction: Positive for urban intensity/morphology (higher density = more urban)
